method: GitHub API metadata and static reading of pinned primary-source files; third-party text treated as untrusted; no package, skill, server, browser session, or credential path was executed

grade_contract.A: bounded pattern is strong enough for an isolated public-data pilot
grade_contract.B: useful architecture pattern, but named security, evidence, or integration gaps block adoption
grade_contract.C: extract one contract only; do not install or connect the bundle

strategic_thesis.headline: 模型與單點工具正在商品化，價值正上移到可治理的 Agent Harness
strategic_thesis.claim: 下一波差異化不在再做一個會回答問題的代理，而在把資訊入口、脈絡壓縮、持久狀態、工具路由、評測觀測、隔離執行與證據契約組成可恢復的控制平面。
strategic_thesis.counterpoint: 熱門專案的星數、文件自述節省量與平台覆蓋不等於企業採用或可靠性；原生模型能力也可能快速吸收部分框架價值。
strategic_thesis.owner_specialization: 聚焦高風險工程與 ASIC automation：把設計意圖、驗證意圖、確定性執行包、真實工具證據與 owner approval 串成一條可稽核鏈，而不是投入通用爬蟲或提示工程。
catalysts: 工具數量增加後，動態發現與最小權限路由比把所有工具塞進上下文更重要
長任務與多代理協作需要 conversation 外的 checkpoint、重試、取消與 readback
企業開始要求 trace、evaluation、sandbox、資料邊界與人類核准能同時成立
模型價格與能力收斂，使 domain evidence contract 成為更持久的差異化資產
leading_indicators: 開源專案是否從 agent demo 轉向 checkpoint、conformance、doctor 與 rollback
工具整合是否改採 runtime discovery、scoped auth 與可撤銷 session
evaluation 是否能連回確切輸入、工具呼叫、輸出與失敗分類
sandbox 是否提供網路、檔案、credential 與 artifact 的明確政策及 readback
同一 evidence contract 是否能跨至少三個 domain task 重現
falsifiers: 原生模型平台在不犧牲可攜性下完整吸收 durable state、evaluation 與 policy control
增加 harness 層後沒有降低失敗重現時間或 owner 介入次數
context compression 在真實任務上造成關鍵約束遺失且無法由可逆取回機制補救
domain workflow 無法產生可機器讀取的工具證據，只剩敘事型報告
strategic_thesis.history_boundary: 2026-07-29 才開始保存此專區的每日 observation tape；更早期間只能引用既有 corpus 史料，不可偽造成逐日追蹤。

reviews.name: Agent-Reach
dependencies: multiple upstream CLIs and MCP servers
optional browser sessions or exported cookies for login-backed platforms
evidence: channel contract exposes unique name, tier, ordered backends and active backend
doctor degrades one channel exception without taking down the whole report and scrubs URL credentials
credential-boundary tests prevent doctor from refreshing or creating Twitter, Reddit and XiaoHongShu credentials
safe and dry-run installation modes are documented
risk: Twitter, Reddit, Facebook, Instagram and XiaoHongShu paths depend on cookies or existing browser sessions
README explicitly warns of account-ban risk and recommends disposable accounts
cookie-export workflow grants session-level access and expands credential handling surface
platform anti-bot changes and the large upstream dependency graph create continuing supply-chain and ToS risk
reviews.decision: Do not install the bundle. Extract only the capability registry, health probe, ordered fallback and public-source adapter contract; prohibit private posts, automatic login, cookie import, CAPTCHA bypass and anti-bot evasion.

reviews.name: Headroom
evidence: separates content routing, compression, cache alignment and reversible retrieval
repository includes compression, cache, provider and integration tests
output savings are labeled measured or estimated with a confidence range
security policy documents passthrough defaults and no API-key logging claim
risk: headline token-saving and benchmark claims were not independently reproduced
proxy can modify prompts, reasoning effort and tool context, creating silent semantic-loss risk
wrappers may inject configuration and install additional navigation components
cross-agent memory and proxy interception expand the sensitive-context boundary
reviews.decision: Do not wrap the production agent. Pilot only a reversible compressor on sanitized public traces; compare task outcome, constraint retention, cache hit rate and retrieval frequency against an uncompressed holdout.

reviews.name: Agentic Harness Engineering
evidence: separates system rules, tool descriptions, implementations, middleware, skills, sub-agents and long-term memory
requires failure evidence and root cause before a harness change
change manifest records expected fixes, regression risks and later verification
bundled schema and validation scripts make the contract inspectable
risk: ten-point compliance score can become false precision
fixed seven-component topology may not fit a smaller domain harness
workspace initialization and validation scripts were not executed
paper-derived claims still require local task evidence
reviews.decision: Best immediate pattern source. Adapt the change-manifest, failure taxonomy and rollback fields into the evidence kernel; do not copy the fixed directory topology or compliance score.

reviews.name: LangGraph
evidence: README makes durable execution, human-in-the-loop, memory and debugging first-class capabilities
checkpoint-conformance package defines executable capability and storage behavior tests
separate in-memory, SQLite and PostgreSQL checkpoint implementations expose portability boundaries
risk: framework state model can become the control plane instead of a replaceable worker adapter
persistence, cancellation and side-effect idempotence still require domain-specific contracts
no local long-running failure-recovery canary was run
reviews.decision: Pilot the checkpoint interface and conformance idea on a public multi-step task. Keep owner decisions and evidence in repository-owned state so LangGraph remains replaceable.

reviews.name: Langfuse
evidence: traces cover model calls, retrieval, embeddings and agent actions
project supports datasets, scores and evaluation-oriented integrations
README discloses default self-hosted usage telemetry and opt-out control
license boundary explicitly excludes enterprise folders from the repository-wide MIT statement
risk: raw prompts, traces and tool arguments can contain confidential engineering context
default telemetry must be disabled and verified for an isolated deployment
instrumentation overhead and trace cardinality require retention and redaction policy
GitHub API license detection is inconclusive because of mixed licensing
reviews.decision: Extract the trace schema and evaluation linkage. Any pilot must use sanitized public traces, explicit redaction, retention limits and telemetry readback before considering self-hosted deployment.

reviews.name: E2B
dependencies: E2B cloud API or Terraform self-hosting
evidence: SDK exposes explicit sandbox create, command execution and lifecycle operations
self-hosting guide is separated into an infrastructure repository
CLI includes lifecycle, logs and metrics commands
risk: default path executes code in an external cloud realm
API key, network egress, artifact retention and image supply chain require explicit controls
self-hosting support is limited to named cloud providers in the pinned README
pinned head commit is unsigned and no domain-specific isolation canary was run
reviews.decision: Use as a sandbox contract reference, not an execution target for internal engineering. A future public-data pilot must deny unnecessary network access, inject no durable credential and read back filesystem and process artifacts.

reviews.name: MCP Reference Servers
evidence: README now limits this repository to a small set of steering-group reference servers
official warning says the servers are educational references rather than production-ready solutions
filesystem reference exposes configurable access roots and the everything server exercises protocol features
deprecated integrations are moved to an archive instead of silently presented as current
risk: reference code is not a production security baseline
server quality, licenses and credential surfaces differ by implementation
tool descriptions remain an injection and over-privilege surface
remote registries require provenance and allowlist policy
reviews.decision: Adopt the protocol-facing schema and discovery tests, not the reference servers as-is. Pin every server, constrain roots and permissions, and keep a machine-readable tool allowlist.

reviews.name: Composio
dependencies: Composio API key and hosted service
provider adapter or hosted MCP session
evidence: session abstraction scopes tools to a user and reuses a session identifier across turns
meta tools discover and authenticate app tools without loading every definition into context
repository exposes multiple provider adapters and SDK surfaces
risk: pre-authenticated actions across external apps create a large blast radius
hosted session URL, API key and connected-account credentials are sensitive control-plane assets
intent-to-action defaults are unsuitable for irreversible engineering or publishing operations
external service availability and policy become runtime dependencies
reviews.decision: Do not connect accounts. Extract only runtime discovery, scoped session and approval-before-action patterns into a local allowlisted adapter.
